address: Cooper's Hill Lane, Englefield Green, Surrey,TW20 0YO
bio: Treat yourself and your loved ones to Afternoon Tea in a luxury setting surrounded by picturesque garden views. Langton's provides the perfect space to relax, unwind and indulge in everyone's favourite Great British tradition.  Nestled inside the luxury village of Cooper's Hill, Langton's blends stylish, contemporary decor with quintessential English charm.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a tempting array of delicate finger sandwiches, homemade buttery scones and a selection of decadent hand-crafted cakes. All of this can be enjoyed with a pot of tea or freshly brewed coffee. If you're feeling fancy, why not upgrade to include a glass of Prosecco, Champagne or even a gin and tonic?  Langton's is located in the village of Englefield Green, within the 68 acres of Magna Carta Park.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
